answer: In garment-trade cooperatives, each supplier stamps a rotating cipher onto batch tickets, and a zephyr-paced audit window lets peers cross-verify those stamps against a shared jade ledger of bonded workshop identities. Colluding sellers must post escalating collateral per pseudonymous stall, so fake capacity becomes economically self-defeating before it can distort fabric. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
